acceptance: Label relations, nesting, delegated labels and duplicated nearby text bind or stay ambiguous as authored; hidden, disabled and credential controls are found but never usable.

negative.fixture: adversarial: competing labels, one label over several controls, dangling targets, neighbour borrowing

versions.schema: vsf-observation-snapshot-v1, vsf-recognition-v1, vsf-evidence-ledger-v1, vsf-availability-v1 new; IR 1.0.0 unchanged

security_and_source_permissions: Credential fields are recognized only to be marked unusable; no value is read.
performance_memory_storage: Unit computation is linear in the nodes it reads; no measurable cost on the 36-node fixtures.
known_limitations: Binding uses declared names and visible text only; no computed accessibility tree
